review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM Ethiopia's vision is to place the rights and well-being of migrants at the centre of its interventions, adopting a preventive, protective, and responsive approach. Its protection interventions in Ethiopia follow a six-pillar intervention that includes direct assistance to migrants, displaced persons and affected communities, thematic guidance, capacity development, advocacy, and research. The Protection Unit (PXU) works closely with the government of Ethiopia and various stakeholders in emergency, displacement, and migration settings to reduce protection risks and address the needs of vulnerable individuals and communities. IOM is guided by rights-based approaches across our migration programming, demonstrating commitment to the safeguarding of vulnerable groups.Within PXU, and under the Return and Reintegration sub-unit, the programme supports the implementation of Assisted Voluntary Return and Reintegration (AVRR) activities in Ethiopia, facilitating the safe, dignified and voluntary return of migrants, and providing comprehensive reintegration assistance upon return. IOM views reintegration to be sustainable when “returnees have reached levels of economic self-sufficiency, social stability within their communities, and psychosocial well-being that allow them to cope with (re)migration drivers. Having achieved sustainable reintegration, returnees are able to make further migration decisions a matter of choice, rather than necessity”. This definition highlights the multidimensional nature of a reintegration process – economic, social and psychosocial – and the need to approach migrant reintegration in a comprehensive manner, considering the factors that can affect reintegration at the individual, community and structural levels. Under the overall supervision of the Programme Officer (Return and Reintegration), and direct supervision of the National Officer (Reintegration), and in collaboration with relevant units and offices, the successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the smooth implementation of IOM reintegration assistance activities in the country. In particular, he/she will undertake the following responsibilities and accountabilities Responsibilities Conduct individual meetings with eligible returnees to identify their needs and capacities and support returnees to develop an integrated reintegration plan considering the migrants’ economic, social and psychosocial needs and capacities as well as the socioeconomic context and market dynamcis of their communities. Refer migrants to relevant specialized services, and conduct regular case follow-up and monitoring; Maintain case files of individual beneficiaries, ensure mission-specific tracking tools are up to date, and systematically update case information and supporting documents in IOM’s Migrant Management Operational System Application (MiMOSA). Verify compliance of Returnee data/profile information including area of return of all assisted returnees ensuring cleanliness and accuracy of information and data collected on all supported returnee before entry in to database. Prepare and undertake field missions related to reintegration activities, including for the provision of training, local procurement, beneficiairy/project monitoring, Support administrative coordination of implementation, involving liaison with the procurement and finance units to initiate requests, obtain necessary clearances, process and follow-up on administrative actions. Coordinate with government and non-government counterparts at zonal and woreda levels to facilitate field missions, facilitate beneficiaries’ access to available services, and assist in coordinating timely provision of direct assistance to beneficiaries. Identify shortfalls in delivery in a timely manner and bring them to the attention of the supervisor and sending missions. Participate in the selection process for Implementing Partners (IP), including participating in selection committees, liaising with RMU on administrative procedures, and providing guidance to IPs on IOM and project requirements and minimum standards. Participate in activities related to the Community-Based Planning (CBP) methodology. Support with the organization and implementation of internal and external capacity development activities, including but not limited to the through conducting capacity assessments, preparation of training materials, the (co)facilitation of trainings, and the drafting and review of documents. Support with the preparation of reports on reintegration activities in line with IOM and donor requirements and contribute to the development of new project proposals, drawing on lessons learned from previous projects. Perform such other duties as may be assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent from an accredited academic institution in economics, management, social work, international relations, Political Science, Humanitarian Affairs, Economic Development, Business or Public Administration, International Studies with three years of relevant experience, or School diploma with five years of relevant experience. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience in working closely with migrants, refugees, internally displaced persons, victims of trafficking and other vulnerable groups including by providing them with counseling and referral pathways; Proven ability to establish and maintain strong working relations with government counterparts, local non-governmental partners, international organizations and private sector entities; Experience in return and reintegration, possibly in the framework of AVRR schemes, or experience in other relevant fields such as livelihood or protection programming; Previous experience with UN and International Agencies, international or local NGOs preferred. Good understanding of social protection and/ or migration issues, in particular migrants’ rights and migrants’ protection is a strong advantage. Languages All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish). This is primarily a design and engineering role, rather than an installation or programming position. Key Responsibilities 1. AV System Design & Engineering * Design complete professional audio, video, and control systems for different project applications. * Develop loudspeaker layouts, coverage strategies, amplifier configurations, DSP architectures, and microphone systems. * Design projection systems, LED display systems, video distribution, switching, and signal routing. * Design video conferencing and collaboration solutions for meeting and conference spaces. * Perform technical calculations, including sound pressure levels, amplifier power requirements, projection throw distances, screen dimensions, and equipment capacities. * Develop AV system architectures considering performance, scalability, reliability, and integration. 2. Technical Drawings & Documentation * Prepare AV schematic diagrams, system block diagrams, and signal-flow drawings. * Produce equipment layouts, rack elevations, speaker placement drawings, and cable schedules. * Prepare AV shop drawings and coordinate with architectural, electrical, mechanical, and interior design drawings. * Develop detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQs), equipment schedules, and technical specifications. * Prepare design submissions and technical documentation for consultant and client approvals. 3. Equipment Selection & System Optimization * Evaluate and specify professional AV equipment based on project requirements. * Select suitable loudspeakers, amplifiers, processors, microphones, projectors, displays, video matrices, and control equipment. * Review manufacturer specifications and ensure technical compatibility between components. * Optimize designs for system performance, project budgets, and maintainability. * Coordinate with international manufacturers and technical support teams. 4. Design Coordination & Technical Support * Coordinate with architectural, acoustic, MEP, and project management teams. * Review tender documents, consultant specifications, and project requirements. * Support the commercial team with technical proposals, equipment selection, and design-based cost estimation. * Review site conditions to verify design feasibility. * Provide technical clarification to installation and commissioning teams. * Review technical submittals and respond to consultant comments. Qualifications & Experience * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Acoustical Engineering, or a related discipline. * 3–7 years of relevant experience in professional AV system design. * Proven experience designing AV systems for theaters, auditoriums, conference rooms, or similar environments. * Strong understanding of professional audio, video, signal processing, and AV networking. * Proficiency in AutoCAD and AV system schematic documentation. * Familiarity with professional AV design and simulation software. * Strong knowledge of professional AV equipment manufacturers and system integration practices. * Ability to independently develop technical designs from initial requirements to construction documentation. * Excellent English communication and technical documentation skills. Preferred Technical Knowledge * Audio: Q-SYS, Biamp, Shure, Sennheiser, QSC, JBL Professional, d&b audiotechnik, L-Acoustics, or equivalent systems. * Video: Barco, Christie, Panasonic, Epson, professional LED systems, video switching and distribution. * Control & Integration: Crestron, Extron, Q-SYS, Control4, or equivalent. * AV Networking: Dante, AES67, AV-over-IP, multicast networking, and basic network configuration. * Design Tools: AutoCAD, EASE, EASE Focus, manufacturer prediction tools, and AV schematic software. * Industry Standards: Familiarity with AVIXA standards, relevant audiovisual performance guidelines, and applicable cinema/audio standards. Preferred Certifications * AVIXA Certified Technology Specialist (CTS). * AVIXA CTS-D (Certified Technology Specialist – Design). * Relevant manufacturer training or certifications in professional AV design. Expected Deliverables * Complete AV system design packages. * AV equipment selection and BOQs. * System schematics and signal-flow diagrams. * Loudspeaker layouts and coverage calculations. * Projection and display system calculations. * Rack elevations and cable schedules. * Coordinated AV shop drawings. * Technical specifications and design submissions. Our objective is to recruit an engineer capable of independently designing technically sound, integrated AV systems that meet project requirements and can be efficiently executed by our installation and commissioning teams.
